notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/30/1469524129-srg-kraken-1.gif

Hello Space Runners, 

We're pleased to release a fifth update for Space Run Galaxy!

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version! 

Here is the patch log for the version 1.0.5: 

Global Balance

In order to smooth the overall progression, we adjusted some rewards and restrictions in the game. This should lead to an overall less grindy and more pleasant experience, especially at the beginning of the game.

Story missions now always offer an additional Space Credits bonus to their rewards. Space Credits are very versatile and can help to buy some missing resources, or new ships.
Some mechanics now have more categories available, especially the basic one (Yellow). Because they require multiple types of resources, yellow modules are already difficult to craft and extra cells are often critical to get. This should help to craft these modules more frequently, especially when combined whith the first balance point.

Client
Fix of black screen bugs on Radeon and Intel HD graphic cards.
Added an option to switch between push & toggle for in-game zoom in & out.
Improved sound management to avoid too many being played at a time.
Fix of a bug that could make the ship disappear after landing on a station.
Fixed a bug on plasma cannon that could lead to a non constructible space on ship
Fix of a bug that could lead to weapons aiming at unreachable targets.

Servers
Various optimizations

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/26/1467300336-srg-planets-1.gif

Hey Space Runners,

We're pleased to release a third update for Space Run Galaxy!

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version! 

Here is the patch log for the version 1.0.3: 

Servers
Fixed a compatibility bug from v1.0.1 to v1.0.2 that could lead to missions ending with more cargo than intended.
Various performance optimizations.

Client
Various network performance improvements.
Some loadings & video memory optimizations.
Fixed in-game User Interface to fit 5/4 resolutions.
Fixed 'Gotta Craft'em all' achievement & badge (retroactive)
Fixed the 'create sale' button in the merchant section that could lead to an invalid network request when published sales list is already full.
Fixed modules with a switch ability that could lead to invalid occupation behaviors or construction removal by PSY cargo.
Fixed a bug that could lead to have 0 Thurst when restarting a run after being destroyed by a boss.
On delivery rewards, you can now click the 'Thank you!' button even if some random rewards are unpacked to collect them all.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey Space Runners,

We're pleased to release a second update for Space Run Galaxy!

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version!

Here is the patch log:

Servers
Many performance improvements.
Client
Various network requests improvements.
Crash fix : first mission of the game can no longer be abandoned (which lead to a corrupted profile).
Crash fix : hitting the '0' key during a run while a contruction menu is opened no longer crashes the game.
Fixed all badges and achievements unlocking.
Fixed a case where focus could be regained when removing an upgrader from ship.
Player Profiles can now be consulted from any player contract or sale offer.
Various text corrections.

Have fun in space,
The Passtech Games Team
